comparison.objective: Clear boxes from a marked emergency-exit walkway without losing them; unrelated to damper adjustment.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated rigid pick-place with spatial classification, not fine tool use, adjustment, or force-limited locking.
comparison.success_condition: Full score when no box blocks the corridor and none falls; centreline and longitudinal bounds are specified. Candidate requires quantified mechanical cycle performance.
comparison.reason: Generic transport primitives do not make workspace clearing overlap with commissioning.
